dependencies.required_evidence: Both diagnostic full-corpus q1 arms are terminal, exact, independently verified, and package-identical.
A retained raw report produced on the execution host identifies Geekbench 5 and contains exactly one positive single-core score.
The packaged compressor, head, and archive match the A/B artifacts by bytes and SHA-256.

contract.pass_rule: Both exact-package stages return zero, restore canonical enwik9, complete every guard-v3 measurement, remain strictly below their independently computed wall limits and resource limits, and encounter no guard or cgroup max/OOM event.

activation_requirements: The live qm8 arm and one clean Arm B are terminal and independently verified.
The exact A/B-identical package is retained read-only.

The raw Geekbench 5 report and stable host fingerprint are retained under the candidate result root; independent verification reproduces the machine-id digest, uname architecture, and CPU model set on the current host.
The runtime coordinator, stage command manifest, scratch roots, cgroups, and lease transitions are frozen and content-addressed.
The exclusive full-1G lease and lock are absent before execution.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes runtime eligibility only for the exact package on the measured host.
It does not establish q1 probability identity, qualification by itself, compression improvement, Gamma authorship, or score credit.
The existing qm8 diagnostic timings have no authority under this contract.
